responsibility: Defines the low-level whole-number lexical conversion interface for INTEGER and CARDINAL text in gm2. It declares finite-state scanner entry points for signed and unsigned decimal forms, string-format classification, value extraction, decimal-length computation for output sizing, and a module-specific exception-state query, making it the parsing/validation core that higher-level whole-number string and channel I/O modules build on.
same_name_distinction: This .def file exposes the low-level whole-number conversion interface—scanner entry points, format/value/length routines, and the exception query—while the same-stem .mod file contains the finite-state parsing logic and exception raising behavior.
